items.html: And the reason is that the Mochin enter from above downward, and at first they encounter Leah and enter into her. However, know that sometimes, when the Mochin enter to enlarge Rachel, then the two of them, Rachel and Leah, become mixed and joined together. Because the length of the NHY of Ima are as long as the measure of the length of all of ZA, whose length is like the length of Leah and Rachel together; therefore, when the NHY enter within the Nukva, they must spread in the two females, Leah and Rachel, to be clothed within them, for one Nukva will not suffice to clothe them.
